en.text: The bird is freed.
en.context: Iconic tweet after completing Twitter acquisition

zh.text: 鸟儿自由了。
zh.context: 完成Twitter收购后的标志性推文

en.text: Free speech is the bedrock of democracy. Without it, we have nothing.
en.context: Core statement on importance of free speech

zh.text: 言论自由是民主的基石。没有它，我们一无所有。
zh.context: 关于言论自由重要性的核心声明

en.text: I bought Twitter because it's important to have a digital town square where people can speak freely.
en.context: Explaining rationale for Twitter acquisition

zh.text: 我收购Twitter是因为拥有一个人们可以自由发言的数字公共广场很重要。
zh.context: 解释收购Twitter的理由

en.text: Twitter Files are revealing the truth about government censorship. The public deserves to know.
en.context: Releasing Twitter Files exposing censorship

zh.text: Twitter文件正在揭示政府审查的真相。公众有权知道。
zh.context: 发布Twitter Files揭露审查内幕

en.text: Content moderation should follow the law, not the political preferences of the moderators.
en.context: Commentary on content moderation principles

zh.text: 内容审核应该遵循法律，而不是审核员的政治偏好。
zh.context: 关于内容审核原则的评论

en.text: X will be the everything app. Free speech, payments, video, everything in one place.
en.context: Describing X platform vision

zh.text: X将成为万能应用。言论自由、支付、视频，一切在一个地方。
zh.context: 描述X平台的愿景

en.text: The old Twitter suppressed free speech. The new X will amplify it.
en.context: Contrasting old Twitter and new X on free speech

zh.text: 旧Twitter压制了言论自由。新的X将放大它。
zh.context: 对比旧Twitter和新X的言论自由立场

en.text: Community Notes is the best content moderation system ever invented. The people decide what's true.
en.context: Praising Community Notes feature

zh.text: Community Notes是有史以来最好的内容审核系统。人民决定什么是真的。
zh.context: 赞扬Community Notes功能

en.text: Censorship is never the answer. Bad ideas should be defeated with better ideas, not silenced.
en.context: Philosophical statement against censorship

zh.text: 审查永远不是答案。坏主意应该被更好的主意击败，而不是被噤声。
zh.context: 关于反对审查的哲学声明

en.text: X now has more daily active users than ever before. Free speech is a growth strategy.
en.context: X user growth data and free speech connection

zh.text: X现在的日活跃用户比以往任何时候都多。言论自由是一种增长策略。
zh.context: X用户增长数据与言论自由的关系

en.text: The mainstream media hates X because they can't control the narrative anymore. That's a feature, not a bug.
en.context: Commentary on mainstream media hostility toward X

zh.text: 主流媒体讨厌X，因为他们再也无法控制叙事了。这是一个特性，不是bug。
zh.context: 关于主流媒体对X敌意的评论

en.text: I will never compromise on free speech. It's the one thing I will fight for to the end.
en.context: Firm statement on free speech stance

zh.text: 我永远不会在言论自由上妥协。这是我愿意为之战斗到底的一件事。
zh.context: 关于言论自由立场的坚定声明

en.text: Advertisers who left X because of free speech pressure will eventually come back. Principles matter more than money.
en.context: Commentary on advertiser boycott of X

zh.text: 因为言论自由压力而离开X的广告商最终会回来。原则比金钱更重要。
zh.context: 关于广告商抵制X的评论

en.text: Community Notes has been fact-checking the fact-checkers. The irony is beautiful.
en.context: Commentary on Community Notes correcting traditional fact-checkers

zh.text: Community Notes一直在事实核查事实核查者。这种讽刺很美。
zh.context: 关于Community Notes纠正传统事实核查的评论

en.text: X is the last major social media platform that truly supports free speech. We must protect it.
en.context: Emphasizing X's position as free speech bastion

zh.text: X是最后一个真正支持言论自由的主要社交媒体平台。我们必须保护它。
zh.context: 强调X作为言论自由堡垒的地位

en.text: The government tried to censor Americans on Twitter. The Twitter Files proved it. Accountability is coming.
en.context: Commentary on government censorship and Twitter Files

zh.text: 政府试图在Twitter上审查美国人。Twitter文件证明了这一点。问责即将到来。
zh.context: 关于政府审查和Twitter Files的评论

en.text: Free speech isn't just about protecting popular opinions. It's about protecting the unpopular ones too.
en.context: Philosophical reflection on scope of free speech protection

zh.text: 言论自由不只是保护受欢迎的观点。它也保护不受欢迎的观点。
zh.context: 关于言论自由保护范围的哲学思考

en.text: X has 600 million monthly active users. The free speech platform is winning.
en.context: X user growth milestone

zh.text: X有6亿月活跃用户。言论自由平台正在获胜。
zh.context: X用户增长里程碑

en.text: When you control information, you control everything. That's why free speech on X is so important.
en.context: Commentary on information control and free speech

zh.text: 当你控制信息时，你就控制了一切。这就是为什么X上的言论自由如此重要。
zh.context: 关于信息控制和言论自由的评论

en.text: The enemies of free speech are getting more desperate. That means we're winning.
en.context: Commentary on anti-free speech forces' reaction

zh.text: 言论自由的敌人越来越绝望。这意味着我们正在获胜。
zh.context: 关于反言论自由势力反应的评论

en.text: X is the digital public square. Everyone has the right to be heard, regardless of their views.
en.context: Reaffirming X's role as public square

zh.text: X是数字公共广场。每个人都有被听到的权利，无论他们的观点如何。
zh.context: 重申X作为公共广场的角色

en.text: Free speech is under attack worldwide. X is the last line of defense. We will not back down.
en.context: Commentary on global threats to free speech

zh.text: 言论自由在全球受到攻击。X是最后一道防线。我们不会退缩。
zh.context: 关于全球言论自由威胁的评论

en.text: The Twitter Files showed that the FBI regularly contacted Twitter to suppress stories. This is unconstitutional.
en.context: Twitter Files exposing FBI-Twitter relationship

zh.text: Twitter文件显示FBI定期联系Twitter来压制报道。这是违宪的。
zh.context: Twitter Files揭露FBI与Twitter的关系

en.text: I'd rather have a smaller platform with free speech than a larger one with censorship. Principles don't have a price.
en.context: Trade-off between platform size and principles

zh.text: 我宁愿要一个有言论自由的小平台，也不要一个有审查的大平台。原则没有价格。
zh.context: 关于平台规模与原则的取舍

en.text: X has proven that a free speech platform can thrive. The doubters were wrong. Again.
en.context: Reviewing X free speech model success

zh.text: X已经证明言论自由平台可以蓬勃发展。怀疑者错了。又一次。
zh.context: 回顾X言论自由模式的成功
